notes.title: World Senate Game New Design
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that we have released a new full design for World Senate. This is the perfect way to get you a more immersive experience inside the game with better graphics.

The new design brings a more close experience to pc games to World Senate so you can enjoy the features of the game with a high quality design built with you in mind.

Besides who wouldn't like a good design on a game. Not only our game has lots of features but now also the new design brings more to the player than the previous one.

For some existing players of world senate on steam  the game cache would need to be cleared manually in case the new design doesn't show or is broken:

For Windows OS If affected by this Go to C:/Users/user/AppData/Roaming/yourAppName/Cache and clear everything in the Cache folder. yourAppName should be something like worldsenate. Or just type %appdata% in folder address bar, it should open AppData folder and then navigate the rest of the path.

For Mac OS If affected by this Go to ~/Library/Application Support/yourAppName/Cache and clear everything in the Cache folder. yourAppName should be something like worldsenate.

Unfortunately there's no way to automate the clear of cache since the app uses old cache from user. In our case the cache was cleared automatically but that may depend on user OS configuration.

We wish a happy gaming to you, citizen of World Senate, old or new!

notes.title: World Senate Game Launches Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that we have added Steam Achievements to World Senate. They are a good way to get you a more immersive experience inside the game.

Whatever your feelings regarding achievements, they are without a doubt one of the most significant improvements to gaming in the previous decade. Achievements allow us to play games longer and give us a good feeling inside every time the message 'ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED' appears.

Besides who wouldn't like achievement for every activity he does on a game. Not only our game awards achievements in Steam but you can also view them in-game on your profile and always get a notify in-game when you get a new achievement.

Right now we don't have too many achievements added but the list will continue to increase so you can get an achievement for every activity you do in the game and whatever challenge you may face.

We wish a happy gaming to you, citizen of World Senate, old or new!

notes.title: MacOS Problems Finally Fixed
notes.notes:
Over the last days we have worked on a MacOS fix to the game launch on Steam.

We announce our MacOS users that now the game runs on MacOS without crashes.

Thank you for patience and we hope to see you in game!

notes.title: World Senate Game Launched on Steam Today
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that today we have launched the World Senate Game on Steam so let's hear some words about the game.

World Senate is an online game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a country, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, be a country president, world senator or representative, vote world issues and you can do many other activities.

Upon joining World Senate Game a citizen is assigned to a virtual country citizenship based on they're choice when joined the game. Each of these countries are named after an actual country in the real world. World Senate Game tends to be a combined version of the real world with the fun of a game where citizens can play the game and also follow the footsteps of world politics where anyone can be a country senator or country president and they are chosen by direct vote from other citizens. Training, working, fighting in war, taking part in races, and even managing your country space colony is done on a daily basis.

One of the main drawing points of the game is politics and the game is centred around countries where each countries with it's own players compete for higher ranking and each fight done in game counts to the country power, not just to the player. Moreover you decide the time you want to invest in it so you can have fun whatever the time you have for playing games.

The game is free to play and we hope you will like this game so have a great game experience!
